reviews.comment: The reviews are pretty accurate: smart guy, but can't teach. He's very disorganized, and if you don't get a front row seat, good luck hearing him and seeing the board. He often tries to cram one last example in the last 2 minutes of class it ends up going 5 minutes past class time and he just rushes through the example, and we learn nothing.
Although he was a very kind man, I learned nothing at all in lecture. Going to lecture was pointless, I taught myself all of the information. If this sounds like a fun time to you, go ahead!
PHYS206 is a trash class but Sezgin was fine. Just study outside and you'll do well.

Nice enough guy and very intelligent just CANNOT teach. Taught the entire course to myself, only went to lecture for iclicker. Again, very sweet man, but please save yourself from having to learn everything outside of lecture and pick a different prof. The course is set up so that learning on ur own wasnt too bad but having a good prof is ideal.

Overall, he is a very smart man. However, it is kind of the situation where he is not a very good professor. He is a good person, but not a great teacher. You will have to teach yourself the course with him as your prof. Homeworks and SI are the biggest helpers with him as your prof. Taking Youngs or Mays as they actually make the common exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Ergin is fine, but other 206 profs are leagues better, take them instead. Ergin is insanely smart, so he looses grasp of how little his students know when he's teaching. His lectures are meh. We had mike youngs come and teach a class when he was gone, and it was 10x better. Take him instead, if you get stuck with ergin, its not the end of the world

He is a very humble man - you'll get it. I personally liked him. Exams are common so nothing to fear there. He improved as the semester went on so you might see some reviews talking about his struggles with technology. He is nice enough, but tests are designed to trick you so his examples might seem useless.

He doesn't really grasp the concept of teaching. He speaks about mostly concepts and he doesn't understand how to do anything in class, even messing up grades for us and not even fixing them. If you want to do good in Physics, either don't take him or learn by yourself.

I do like him, and think he knows what he's doing physics wise. But wow, he has no clue how to work technology. Could not figure out IClicker for the life of him and can never figure out how to work his slideshows. Really frustrating

Absolute worst professor I've ever had. Graduated now, but he had questioned me "How I even got admitted to graduate school" when I had attended his rare office hours, thankfully was able to take the course somewhere else with a professor who doesn't have an ego.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As someone who took this course twice, Dr. Sezgin is the only reason I was able to pass at all. This class is probably one of the hardest classes at the school. Dr. Segin made it possible by VERY detailed notes, repeating ideas as many times as needed, and going way out of his way to give extra help. He gave a huge curve so that we didn't all fail.

If you can get past his stuttering during lectures than the information he presents is often way above your head. Reduces questions you ask in class to "Come to my office hours". Basically no assistance for exams, have yet to complete the course but going to most likely Q-Drop.

Sezgin is pretty great. He is a very humble man lol (you'll understand when you go to his class). I mostly learned from the pre-lectures on Sapling, but if you're someone who needs lectures, he does a decent job. Clicker questions are a must. Always ready to help his students. Only complaint: he doesn't do live experiments.

This is a great professor who will work with you if you have any problems. His lectures could be a little better since he would always bring problems he had already worked out and go over them if we would work them out in class it would help a lot. As well since he works on a LOs system for exams you can mess up on one then always fix your average.
